head: af112d6365207a5a3f65136c7057d6bb98203c35
rationale: Path handling in model creation: a real failure on nested paths (not in AACR-Bench's references) and the Windows separator gap the references do name.

expect.concern: root.OpenFile creates the file before any parent directory exists (MkdirAll runs later, in createLink), so a nested path such as dir/model.safetensors fails with ENOENT and is reported as an invalid path.
validRelative only treats '/' as a separator, so on Windows backslash and drive-letter paths pass the early check; os.Root still contains them, so it is defense in depth that is lost.
Missing errFilePath handling in the badRequest error checking loop for base model files
Wrong error returned when 'files' is omitted from CreateRequest because r.Files is overwritten with a non-nil empty map

adjudicated.label: valid
adjudicated.reason: Real, low impact: the r.Files error branch omits errFilePath, which the adapters branch includes, so a bad file path is not a 400. (checked against the code by the agent, 2026-09-28)
adjudicated.title: Missing errFilePath handling in the badRequest error checking loop for base model files

adjudicated.label: invalid
adjudicated.reason: Defense in depth only: adapter keys still pass the os.Root containment check and errFilePath returns 400. (checked against the code by the agent, 2026-09-28)
adjudicated.title: Missing early path validation for adapters keys in CreateHandler

adjudicated.label: valid
adjudicated.reason: Real: files is always a non-nil map, so r.Files != nil always holds and the errNeitherFromOrFiles branch is unreachable; omitting files gives the wrong error. (checked against the code by the agent, 2026-09-28)
adjudicated.title: Wrong error returned when 'files' is omitted from CreateRequest because r.Files is overwritten with a non-nil empty map

adjudicated.label: invalid
adjudicated.reason: Negligible: one extra empty-file create and delete per file next to linking or copying the blob. (checked against the code by the agent, 2026-09-28)
adjudicated.title: Redundant synchronous disk write/delete operations per safetensor file during model creation
